name: Kentou Kanami
source:
One of [url=/c11980]Lia's[/url] personal ninjas, she does all the dirty or secret jobs that Lia orders her to do. While seemingly apathetic from the outside, Kanami is actually very concerned with her ability as a ninja. It's implied that she is always training by herself to hone her skills. She longs to be a normal girl, but that's an impossible dream. Lia ordered her to keep tabs on [url=/c735]Rance[/url], a job that she hates since she also hates him.

[spoiler]She later fell in love with Rance and gave birth to his daughter, [url=/c94279]Kentou Uzume[/url].[/spoiler]
